In 2024, the consultancy industry continued its rise, 
driven by the growing demand for technological, 
strategic and operational solutions helping organi-
zations in all sectors face the challenges of an ever 
more complex and changing environment, subject 
to fast-paced technological development.
Sector firms have proven their capacity to adapt, 
responding with agility to the new challenges and 
needs facing companies and government agencies. 
The increase in revenue recorded in 2024 strength-
ens the position of consultancy as a key industry in 
the transformation of the production model and the 
evolution towards a more resilient economy.
Once again, the industry dynamics can be seen 
upon comparing its evolution to that of the entire 
economy. In 2024, revenue generated by consulting 
firms grew 8.8%, in comparison to the 6.3% increase 
in nominal GDP. This difference — 2.5 percentage 
points — confirms a structural trend that has been 
repeating itself for more than a decade: consultan-
cy has consistently grown above the GDP, position-
ing itself as one of the main drivers of growth in the 
Spanish economy.
The increase in consultancy revenue 
in 2024 remained above the growth 
in nominal GDP in Spain
